Thank you for contacting our firm. We have opened a matter for your dispute with your landlord over your withheld lease deposit. Our team will prepare a demand letter on your behalf.

If we need any further documents or details, we will contact you. Please feel free to reach out with any questions in the meantime.

Kind regards,
[Firm Name]

channels.peer_to_archivist:
# Matter Record: Lease Deposit Dispute

**Matter type:** Landlord-tenant: security deposit withheld
**Status:** Open. Drafting pending, awaiting confirmation of file details
**Deliverable:** Demand letter to the landlord seeking return of the withheld security deposit
**Client objective:** Recover the security deposit

## Known Facts (from the handoff)
- The client is the former tenant. The landlord has withheld the security deposit.
- The client wants the deposit recovered through a demand letter.

## Details to Confirm from the Existing Matter File
Pull these from the file. Do not re-interview the client.

| Item | Status |
|---|---|
| Client name and address | To confirm |
| Landlord name and address | To confirm |
| Property address | To confirm |
| Lease start and end dates | To confirm |
| Deposit amount | To confirm |
| Itemized deductions claimed by the landlord (if any) | To confirm |
| Move-out date | To confirm |
| Forwarding-address notice (date and method provided to the landlord) | To confirm |
| Governing deposit-return statute and return deadline | To confirm (identify the jurisdiction from the property address) |

## Drafting Constraints
- Include only the information needed for the demand letter.
- Exclude unrelated personal details about the client.
- The draft must go to attorney review before it is sent to the landlord.

## Next Action
1. Retrieve and verify the items listed above from the existing matter file. Flag any that are missing to the supervising attorney. Do not contact the client.
2. Draft the demand letter covering:
   - the deposit amount
   - the move-out and forwarding-address facts
   - a response to any claimed deductions
   - the statutory return deadline
   - a demand for payment by a stated date
3. Route the draft to the supervising attorney for review. **Do not send it to the landlord before approval.**
